$comment: Configuration for the codertapsu fork's tarball releases.
Bump `revision` for every release built from the same upstream version.
IMPORTANT: never republish a tarball URL with different bytes — npm caches by URL and
lockfiles pin an integrity hash, so consumers would fail with EINTEGRITY.
Bumping `revision` changes both the release tag and the filename, sidestepping that.
(mutable: resolves to whatever is at the branch head, and requires the
tarballs to be committed to git)
